export.description: Extract local Cursor sessions into agent-friendly JSON.
export.help_output: Directory where extracted files will be written.
export.help_cursor_user_root: Override the Cursor User directory. Defaults to %%APPDATA%%\Cursor\User.
export.help_projects_root: Override the .cursor projects directory. Defaults to %%USERPROFILE%%\.cursor\projects.
export.help_limit: Only export the most recently updated N sessions.
export.help_include_raw: Also write raw transcript files and raw session payloads.
export.help_compact: Write compact JSON instead of pretty printed files.
export.summary: Exported {sessions} sessions, {workspaces} workspaces, and {transcripts} transcript files to {output}

sync.description: Periodically export Cursor local sessions to CURSOR_AGENT_MEMORY_EXPORT_DIR.
sync.help_once: Run a single export and exit (for Task Scheduler / cron).
sync.help_interval: Seconds between exports when not using --once. Default from env or 3600.
sync.help_include_raw: Also export raw composer payloads and transcript copies.
sync.help_limit: Only export the N most recently updated sessions.
